## Statement

`claim <- acquire(job)` — Claim the job row

## Effect

Locks the job row for this worker.

## Contract

- Pre: job exists
- Post: claim.ok ⇔ the row was locked by this worker before the deadline

## Realization

Target: `postgres: SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
Adaptation: post → SKIP LOCKED returns zero rows when another worker holds the lock
